data.name: NULL ETERNITY: Last Contact
data.detailed_description:
NULL ETERNITY: LAST CONTACT

You wake up and don’t remember how you got here. Only one name breaks through the silence in your mind: “Elizabeth.”

A DESCENT INTO THE UNDERGROUND NIGHTMARE

An underground research facility has collapsed.

Something—an unknown factor—has destroyed the stability of the complex, causing a total failure of systems, machinery, and containment.

What was once an advanced scientific base is now a living maze of darkness and uncontrollable structures.

NO COMBAT. ONLY SURVIVAL.

You have no weapons. There is no way to fight what inhabits this place.

You can only:
Hide
Observe
Escape

Survive
The entities patrolling the facility react to your presence… and not all of them behave the same way.

EXPLORATION, DANGER AND DISCOVERY

Traverse interconnected levels within the underground complex.

Complex environmental and logic-based puzzles

Level-based exploration with limited backtracking within each area

Dynamic events and reactive zones

Inventory management and limited resources

Enemy AI with different behaviors and threat levels

Every step forward may unlock something new… or awaken something far worse.

A BURIED STORY

As you ascend, you begin to piece together what happened.

Failed experiments.

Systems that should never have existed.
And a constant echo that follows you:
“Elizabeth.”

NULL ETERNITY

LAST CONTACT is a first-person survival horror experience focused on tension, exploration, and complete player vulnerability.
In this place, survival is not enough.
Understanding what happened is the only way out.

data.short_description: You wake up deep beneath an underground research facility with no memory of how you got there. Only one name remains in your mind: Elizabeth. Solve puzzles, evade failed experiments, and uncover the truth behind the disaster in this first-person sci-fi survival horror experience.

English*, Spanish - Spain

content_descriptors.notes: Last Contact contains horror themes, psychological tension, and scenes involving failed experiments that gave rise to mutated human subjects. Players must explore an underground research facility, solve puzzles, and survive while uncovering the secrets behind the disaster. The game does not contain sexual content or nudity.
